flags.question: Identify all machines with a disk size greater than 256 GB in zone 4.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (m:Machine)-[:TYPE]->(t:Type), (m)-[:ROUTES]->(i:Interface), (i)-[:ROUTES]->(z:Zone)
WHERE t.disk > 256 AND z.zone = 4
RETURN m.name
details: Cypher has (Interface)-[:ROUTES]->(Zone) but schema says Zone->Interface

flags.question: List the first 3 machines that run the latest version of the software 'RHEL'.

MATCH (s:Software {name: 'RHEL'})-[:VERSION]->(v:Version)
WITH s, v
ORDER BY v.name DESC
LIMIT 1
MATCH (m:Machine)-[:RUNS]->(:OS {name: 'RHEL'})-[:INSTANCE]->(v)
RETURN m.name
LIMIT 3
